    body {

      display: flex;

      width: 100%;
      padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
      font-size: 1rem;

      border-radius: var(--border-radius-md);

      outline: none;
      border-color: var(--color-accent);
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-accent) 30%, transparent);
    }
    .url-input::placeholder {
      color: var(--color-text-secondary);
      opacity: 0.6;
    }
    .capture-btn {
      width: 100%;
      padding: 0.875rem 1.5rem;
      font-size: 1rem;
      font-weight: 500;
      border: none;
      border-radius: var(--border-radius-md);
      background: var(--color-accent);
      color: white;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: opacity 0.2s, transform 0.1s;
    }
    .capture-btn:hover:not(:disabled) {
      opacity: 0.9;

    .capture-btn:active:not(:disabled) {
      transform: scale(0.98);
    }
    .capture-btn:disabled {
      opacity: 0.5;
      cursor: not-allowed;
    }
    .status {
      min-height: 1.5rem;
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      color: var(--color-text-secondary);

    .status.error {

    .screenshot {
      display: block;
      width: 100%;
      height: auto;
      max-height: 70vh;
      object-fit: contain;
    }
    .spinner {
      display: inline-block;
      width: 1rem;
      height: 1rem;
      border: 2px solid currentColor;
      border-right-color: transparent;
      border-radius: 50%;
      animation: spin 0.8s linear infinite;
      margin-right: 0.5rem;
      vertical-align: middle;
    }
    @keyframes spin {
      to { transform: rotate(360deg); }

parts.text: Build an app with a text box where I paste a URL. When I click a button, it opens that URL using the browser tool (playwright), takes a screenshot, and shows me the page title and the screenshot in the app.
Build an app with a text box where I paste a URL. When I click a button, it opens that URL using the browser tool, takes a screenshot, and shows me the page title and screenshot.

The app is ready. You can use it here: [URL Screenshot Capture](/a/f38d6e88-9725-4ef4-90ef-b3ebf23695e7)

Enter a URL (e.g., `https://example.com`), click **Capture Screenshot**, and it will open the page in the Playwright browser, retrieve the page title, take a full-page screenshot, and display both in the app.

enhancement.description: Full-page screenshots and titles from any URL via Playwright — paste, capture, view instantly.
enhancement.prompt: Build me an app where I paste a URL, click a button, and it uses Playwright to open the page, grab the title, take a full-page screenshot, and show me both.
enhancement.response:
The URL Screenshot Capture app is ready — paste a URL, click the button, and it loads the page in Playwright, grabs the title, takes a full-page screenshot, and displays both right in the app.

- Text input field for any URL (http/https)
- Playwright browser automation to navigate and render the page
- Full-page screenshot captured via Playwright's screenshot API
- Page title extracted from the loaded document
- Both title and screenshot rendered in the UI for quick review

Just enter a URL like `https://example.com` and hit **Capture Screenshot** — the app handles the rest.
